title: amazing
text: Albert was amazing. He was a great guide, but he also thought of all the little extras. He brought us towels, umbrellas, water, and extras special little touches like fish food and treats for us. Everyone on the boat was watxhing the fish gobble up the food. Wish I could give gim more than 5 stars.
author: Kami_A

title: Albert was great, town and water were beautiful and the history was rich.
text:
Albert was an incredible guide. Shared a lot about the history of the city and landmarks. The itinerary of the morning, was perfect. Seeing Tossa Del Mar in the morning was beautiful, we had the city to ourselves and the weather was not too hot. 
He offered towels, water and an umbrella for the beach and fish food to feed the fish on the boat. 
Great host for the day! Would absolutely recommend this tour.
author: Melanie_A

title: Excellent
text: Great experience. Albert the guide very knowledgeable. Very comfortable van. Beach - lovely. Glass bottomed boat experience- lots of fish. Wear comfy shoes for the walk. Great views and photo opportunities. Albert very good at keeping in contact
author: Victoria_G
